paragraphs.text: The Lady's Path was a road created by Autumn Willow through the Great Wood on the world of Ulgrotha . It connects the Koskun Mountains and An-Havva .

A huge river courses through the middle of the Great Wood, fast and full of rapids. Where the Lady's Path intersects it, the Autumn Willow had the Faeries construct the River Bridge ; she then set them to keep any interlopers from crossing it. Any being who tried to cross that bridge without her permission was beset by a host of Faeries led by the Faerie Nobles who pushed them back; if they persisted in their attempts to cross, the Faeries drove them to their deaths in the frothing water beneath the bridge.
The Spectral Bears that roam the Great Wood are believed to be the personal guardians of Autumn Willow and are often seen escorting caravans from the river bridge to An-Havva.
